Forecast Profit & Loss Statement

The Forecast Profit & Loss Statement form configures parameters for forecast reports.

Set date ranges and forecasts to project financial performance.

Title

Enter a title for this forecast report. Leave blank to use the default title.

Description

Enter an optional description for this forecast configuration.

Periods

Define the forecast periods. You can add multiple periods for comparison.

Footer

Enter text to appear at the bottom of the forecast report.

Show account codes

Check this box to display account codes alongside account names.

Exclude zero balances

Check this box to hide accounts with zero forecasted balances.
